label: PF Backlog 215
title: Backend: model downloader + local cache + license-acceptance gate + models.lock (open-weights)
body:
## Problem / why
Open-weights models (image/video/tts/stt/music/3d/ocr/vlm/embedding) must be fetched, verified, cached,
and license-gated before a self-host adapter can run them. Today there is no downloader, no cache, no
license enforcement, so `provider_kind=self-host` cannot work and packaging could accidentally ship
restricted weights.

## Goal & value
One owner module that downloads only the weights a project's capability pack needs, into a gitignored
local cache, refusing non-bundle-usable weights unless explicitly overridden.

## In scope
- `core/model_manager.py` (single writer): resolve model -> source (HF Hub / ModelScope / URL),
  download with `huggingface_hub` + `hf_transfer`, resume, checksum (sha256).
- Cache layout `product-forge/models/<provider>/<model>@<rev>/` (gitignored) + `models.lock` manifest
  (id, revision, size, sha256, license, fetched_at).
- **License-acceptance gate:** read catalog `license`/`open_weights`/`bundle_allowed`; block
  non-bundle-safe weights unless `PF_ALLOW_RESTRICTED_WEIGHTS=1`.
- Disk/VRAM preflight (size vs free space) + "download only required modalities" (pack-driven).
- CLI: `python -m core.model_manager --list/--ensure <model>/--verify/--prune`.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- `ensure("FLUX.1-schnell")` downloads once, records sha256+license in models.lock, second call is a no-op.
- A restricted model (`FLUX.1-dev`) is refused with a clear message unless the override env is set.
- Downloading is pack-scoped: a text-only project downloads nothing.

## Verification / test plan
- Unit: source resolution, license gate decision table, lock idempotency (fake source, no network).
- Integration: download one small model (e.g. a Piper voice / tesseract tessdata) and verify checksum.
